visual_review.scope: All 30 pages inspected in contact sheets; full-size pages 1 and 23–30 inspected. Final page 23 re-inspected after shortening the critical-gap row label for column spacing. Root independently inspected final pages 26/27 with no changes requested.
visual_review.underfull_box_disposition: Inspected table/source/resource paragraphs; no collisions, clipping or unreadable spacing.
visual_review.scope_limit: Bounded follow-up revision and whole/part consistency review; not a repetition of the historical full editorial pipeline or raw-answer recoding.

semantic_dispositions.pilot: Original 4,224-session/192-pair conditional AI-code inference remains separate and unchanged; follow-up qualification does not retrospectively validate original coding.
semantic_dispositions.followup: 128 sessions comprise 8 donors and 120 cloned recipients: 8 purposive task clusters × 5 conditions × 3 contexts × 1 repeat, tools disabled, fixed model snapshot.
semantic_dispositions.qualification: Actual AI coder/adjudicator qualification passed after collection and before participant coding; invalid-material exercises retained ungraded, unchanged V2 supplement/threshold, no human validation or assessor-error estimate.
semantic_dispositions.primary: Whole-verdict reference agreement AND internal consistency: facts 20/40, EAL 30/40, conventional 33/40; 83 successes, 37 failures, zero unresolved conjunctions.
semantic_dispositions.verdict_uncertainty: Known verdict matches 20/30/33; unresolved verdict judgments 3/3/0 retained. All six ambiguous verdicts are known primary failures owing to contradictory explanations.
semantic_dispositions.canonical: Canonical JSON matches 20/31/33 are separate; explanation grounding unassessed.
semantic_dispositions.attribution: All 40 EAL/conventional full model-visible packet pairs identical; observed accuracy contrast cannot identify EAL implementation effect. Availability cause confounded with task-domain wording.
semantic_dispositions.processing: Offline finish preserves raw source and usage with no extra API calls; processing/collection complete, analysis pending_annotation 6, no diagnostic principal allocation or evaluation.
semantic_dispositions.cost: Configured ledger USD 0.0204097 in four disjoint groups; not invoice or adoption costs.

evidence_basis: Safe aggregated endpoint/resource summaries, independent mechanical collection/derived/archive audits, root-provided qualification/workflow witnesses and independently accepted figures. No raw answers, calibration keys or coder-output content read.
